name: Genetic Primary Orthostatic Disorder

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Genetic Primary Orthostatic Disorder

criteria.description: Sustained drop in systolic blood pressure ≥20 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure ≥10 mmHg within 3 minutes of standing
Exclusion of secondary causes of orthostatic hypotension such as medication effects or systemic diseases
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant or recessive inheritance pattern
Symptoms of orthostatic intolerance persisting for at least 6 months
Abnormal autonomic function tests supporting impaired sympathetic vasoconstriction

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of orthostatic hypotension with exclusion of secondary causes and positive family history
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory

pathognomonic.symptomName: Orthostatic hypotension with symptomatic cerebral hypoperfusion
searchTerms: low blood pressure on standing causing symptoms
faintness due to low standing BP

pathognomonic.notes: Impaired autonomic regulation of blood pressure
searchTerms: difficulty standing due to nerve dysfunction

occasional.symptomName: Nausea during episodes of orthostatic intolerance
Cold extremities related to autonomic dysfunction
searchTerms: cold hands and feet from nerve issues
chilly extremities due to autonomic problems
cold limbs related to nerve dysfunction

rare.notes: Convulsive syncope secondary to cerebral hypoperfusion

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests excluding secondary causes
Possible mild elevation of plasma norepinephrine in supine position
imaging: Cardiac imaging to exclude structural heart disease
genetic: Mutations in genes regulating autonomic nervous system function (e.g., dopamine beta-hydroxylase gene mutations)
other: Abnormal autonomic function tests including tilt-table testing showing orthostatic hypotension

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of underlying systemic disease or medication cause
Reversible with treatment of secondary cause
Marked tachycardia on standing without significant hypotension
Progressive neurodegeneration with parkinsonism and cerebellar signs
Poor response to orthostatic hypotension treatment

redFlags: Presence of neurological deficits beyond autonomic symptoms
references: Orphanet: Genetic Primary Orthostatic Disorder - ORPHA:521232
